1.title: Can Immigration Agents Stop People Based on Appearance?
1.summary: Jazmine Ulloa, our national reporter covering immigration, describes body-camera footage and other court evidence that federal agents used slurs and racially profiled people during immigration sweeps.

2.title: Trump signs order to limit childhood vaccines and split MMR shots
2.summary: The American Academy of Pediatrics calls the recommendation on measles, mumps and rubella shots "dangerous".

3.title: Trump hid in catering truck in secret plane swap over Iran threat, reports say
3.summary: The US president was part of a ruse where reporters were falsely told he was with them on Air Force One leaving a Nato summit in Turkey.

4.title: What We Know About the Earthquake in Colombia
4.summary: The 7.4-magnitude quake, which killed more than 100 people and damaged hundreds of buildings, was the strongest recorded in Colombia in a decade.

5.title: Ousted Syrian dictator Bashar al-Assad sentenced to death in absentia
5.summary: The ex-president is convicted of committing war crimes and crimes against humanity during the country's civil war.

6.title: Russian Civilian Deaths Are Growing Rapidly as Ukraine Expands Its Air War
6.summary: The higher tempo of Ukrainian strikes has fueled discontent among Russians, but it is far from clear that it will change the Kremlin’s calculus about the war.
